ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, from left to right there are six squares of the same size, and inside each square there is a gray shaded region. The 1st shaded region is an L shape formed along the left side and the bottom side. The 2nd is a shape similar to H, with vertical strips on both sides and a horizontal strip connected in the middle, and there are white gaps at the top and bottom. The 3rd is a U shape, with the left, right, and bottom shaded, and in the middle there is a white notch open from the top. The 4th is a cross shape, composed of a vertical strip running through top to bottom and a horizontal strip running through left to right. The 5th is a T shape, with a whole horizontal strip above, and the middle vertical strip going all the way to the bottom side. The 6th is also a cross shape, composed of a vertical strip running through top to bottom and a horizontal strip running through left to right. Reasoning: Let the side length of each square be s, so the perimeter of one square is 4s. In the 1st L shape, the missing part of the outer boundary will be made up by the indented boundary of equal length, so the perimeter is equal to 4s, count it. The 2nd H shape has two white gaps at the top and bottom, and the gaps add extra internal boundary, so the perimeter is greater than 4s, do not count it. The 3rd U shape has a white notch entering from the top, and the two vertical sides of the notch add extra perimeter, so it is greater than 4s, do not count it. The 4th cross shape is a complete vertical strip plus a complete horizontal strip, and the reduced part of the outer boundary and the internal step boundary cancel each other, so the perimeter is equal to 4s, count it. In the 5th T shape, the missing outer boundaries on the two lower sides are replaced by equal amounts by the bottom of the top horizontal strip and the boundaries on the two sides of the vertical strip, so the perimeter is equal to 4s, count it. The 6th is likewise a cross shape of a complete vertical strip plus a complete horizontal strip, and its perimeter is also equal to 4s, count it. Therefore the ones satisfying the condition are the 1st, 4th, 5th, and 6th, for a total of 4.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows six identical squares, each containing a shaded region. How many of the regions have perimeter equal in length to the perimeter of one of the squares?

method.method_draft: Label the six shaded regions from left to right. Let the side length of each square be s, so the square perimeter is 4s. From the image, classify the shaded shapes: 1 is an L-shape along the left and bottom edges; 2 is an H-shape made of two side strips and a middle bar; 3 is a U-shape with a white notch opening from the top; 4 is a plus/cross made by a full vertical strip and full horizontal strip; 5 is a T-shape with a full top bar and a central stem to the bottom; 6 is another cross-like shape made by a full vertical strip and full horizontal strip. For each rectilinear shaded boundary, express the perimeter in terms of s and the internal strip widths/depths. The L-shape perimeter cancels to 4s. The H-shape has extra notch boundary and is greater than 4s unless the middle bar fills the whole square, so it does not count. The U-shape has two extra vertical notch sides, so it is greater than 4s and does not count. A full vertical strip plus full horizontal strip has perimeter 4s by cancellation, so figures 4 and 6 count. The T-shape also cancels to 4s: the missing lower side portions are replaced by equal inner horizontal/vertical boundary contributions, so figure 5 counts. Thus the counting set is figures 1, 4, 5, and 6, giving 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中从左到右有六个相同大小的正方形，每个正方形内有一个灰色阴影区域。第1个阴影是沿左边和底边形成的 L 形。第2个是类似 H 的形状，两侧为竖条，中间有横条连接，上下各有白色缺口。第3个是 U 形，左右和底部为阴影，中间有一个从顶部开口的白色凹口。第4个是十字形，由贯穿上下的竖条和贯穿左右的横条组成。第5个是 T 形，上方是整条横条，中间竖条一直到底边。第6个也是十字形，由贯穿上下的竖条和贯穿左右的横条组成。

推理：设每个正方形的边长为 s，所以一个正方形的周长是 4s。第1个 L 形中，外边界缺少的部分会被内凹边界等长补回，因此周长等于 4s，计入。第2个 H 形有上下两个白色缺口，缺口增加了额外的内部边界，所以周长大于 4s，不计入。第3个 U 形有一个从顶部进入的白色凹口，凹口的两条竖直边增加了额外周长，所以大于 4s，不计入。第4个十字形是完整竖条加完整横条，外边界减少的部分与内部台阶边界相互抵消，周长等于 4s，计入。第5个 T 形中，下方两侧缺失的外边界被顶部横条底部和竖条两侧的边界等量替代，周长等于 4s，计入。第6个同样是完整竖条加完整横条的十字形，周长也等于 4s，计入。因此符合条件的是第1、4、5、6个，共 4 个。
